title: Controlled Engineering Robustness Evaluation of Stage 3 Target-Aware Meal Optimizer

cohort.cohort_reuse_disclosure: Reused from 100-participant budget study cohort; exploratory robustness extension, not independent confirmatory cohort.

target_source.rationale: Strictly evaluates downstream optimizer robustness against model-guided targets without confounding from target-source comparison.

variant_a.label: bounds_based
variant_a.description: Current production objective: calorie deviation + food selection cost.

variant_b.label: target_aware
variant_b.description: Experimental target-aware objective: calorie deviation + food selection cost + normalized L1 target deviations.

solver_configuration.order_strategy: Alternate A->B on even participant indices, B->A on odd participant indices to eliminate order/caching bias.

nominal_baseline.description: Unmodified food catalog and standard baseline constraints.
nominal_baseline.rationale: Establishes reference unperturbed performance under 5.0s budget.

food_avail_10pct.description: Modest food availability restriction (~10% active food removal, nested subset of 20%).
food_avail_10pct.rationale: Simulates modest catalog supply disruption while preserving category feasibility.

food_avail_20pct.description: Stronger food availability restriction (~20% active food removal, strict superset of 10%).
food_avail_20pct.rationale: Simulates acute supply shortage; strictly nests 10% removal for dose-response comparison.

dietary_excl_dairy.description: Complete dairy exclusion (5 items, lactose intolerance / vegan preference).
dietary_excl_dairy.safety_note: Preference/intolerance exclusion only; absence of dairy annotation does not certify allergen-free.
dietary_excl_dairy.rationale: Stresses calcium, B12, riboflavin, and protein optimization from non-dairy sources.

dietary_excl_legume.rationale: Evaluates clean failure detection under hard category rules in PV/combo and substitution in NonVeg.

nutrient_sens_pm5pct.description: Nutrient sensitivity replay: re-evaluates nominal meal plans under +/-5% uniform random perturbation.
nutrient_sens_pm5pct.rationale: Quantifies uncertainty propagation: distinguishes nominal validity from perturbed compliance.

nutrient_sens_pm10pct.description: Nutrient sensitivity replay: re-evaluates nominal meal plans under +/-10% uniform random perturbation.
nutrient_sens_pm10pct.rationale: Stresses nutritional robustness under higher lab/sourcing variance.

statistical_analysis_plan.unit_of_inference: Participant-level paired differences (modes/draws averaged within participant before calculating contrast mean).

exact_tests.unit: One observation per participant within specified mode and scenario

prohibited_practices: No pooled McNemar tests across repeated draws or modes
No zero-imputation of target error for failed plans
No claims of clinical efficacy, medical safety, or Indian validation

corruption_verification_requirements.strict_try_except_pattern: try: validator(corrupted) except RobustnessValidationError: record() else: fail()
